name: PARA-308
notes: Extended barrel: 52 dmg / min 42 (community-measured; ~+12% and ~80% floor). Community-measured: 649 rpm; ammo-refill reload 1.52 tac / 2.50 empty. Fandom max ammo 31+210 is pre-Y6S3 (stale). Recoil: low per-shot recoil, very manageable; main drawback is mediocre fire rate (Fandom).

name: CAMRS
destruction_class: UNVERIFIED:high (Fandom: DMRs breach a barricade or hatch in <10 shots; Y5S1 raised DMR destruction)
notes: PER-OPERATOR: grips (vertical/angled/horizontal) only on Brava's CAMRS; Buck's version has the Skeleton Key underbarrel and no grips. fire_rate is community-measured semi-auto cap (Fandom ~450). max_ammo community-measured 20+1+120; Fandom 21+140 (=161) is above the Y6S3 DMR range 100-140, so treated as stale. Ammo-refill reload (community) 1.36 tac / 2.58 empty. Recoil: high stock kick; Muzzle Brake advised (Fandom).

name: AK-12
notes: No extended barrel. Recoil: harsh vertical and horizontal; horizontal drift worsens from ~4th shot of a spray; recoil increased in Y6S3 (Fandom + Y6S3 DN). Ammo-refill reload (community) 1.49 tac / 2.47 empty. Fandom 31+210 ammo stale (pre-Y6S3).

name: 6P41
chambered_plus_one: no (open bolt; the Y6S3 extra round goes to reserve: 100 + 201)
notes: Fandom gives a single 8.5 s reload (no tactical/empty split); community ammo-refill times 4.29 / 7.33 s. LMG class: -10% movement speed (Y9S1). Recoil: reduced first kick/vertical/lateral and more stable sustained fire since Y9S1; 'relatively controllable' (Fandom).

name: Ballistic Shield
fire_modes: n/a (primary slot; used together with the secondary: PMM or GSh-18)
ads_time_s: 0.50 walking / 0.55 sprinting (pistol ADS while holding shield)
destruction_class: n/a (can no longer dash through undamaged barricades since Y11S1)
notes: See weapons_notes.md 'Ballistic Shield'. No hip fire; secondary fires only in ADS (shield lowered, head exposed). Suppressive fire: 5 hits trigger / 20 hits max intensity / ~7 s falloff; no sprint while suppressed. Melee: 0 dmg (from 65 in Y9S4), knockback. Carrier speed -10% (Fandom, UNVERIFIED current). ADS cancelled while vaulting (Y10S2); projectile throws expose operator (Y10S3); Sledge hammer knocks shield users down (Y10S2); Noor's Horus Lance attaches to shields (Y11S3).

name: 556xi
notes: No extended barrel. Recoil: average vertical and horizontal, overall low (Fandom). Community: 689 rpm, ammo-refill reload 1.30 tac / 2.74 empty. Fandom 31+210 ammo stale.

name: M1014
destruction_class: UNVERIFIED:full-at-close-range (buckshot can break wooden studs/beams per Fandom Destruction)
notes: Y11S3.1: damage 30 per pellet (was 28). Buckshot falloff (Y8S3): 100% 0-5 m, 75% 6-10 m (22), 45% at 13 m+ (13). Headshot pellet = 1.5x after range modifier. fire_rate/reloads are community-measured (Fandom ~200 rpm; no official reload value). Fandom 8+25 ammo stale; Y6S3 primary shotgun range 49-60. Recoil: high kick per shot; ADS view obstructed when fired quickly (Fandom).

name: M4
notes: Extended barrel: 49 dmg / min 39 (community). Recoil: noticeable first-shot kick, subpar vertical; Flash Hider recommended over Compensator (Fandom). Community ammo-refill reload 1.31 tac / 2.70 empty. Attachment availability for Siege X Striker assumed standard (UNVERIFIED).

name: M249
notes: Fandom single reload 7.6 s; community ammo-refill 4.67 / 6.60 s. Y7S3 DN added a Muzzle Brake to Capitao's M249 but current Fandom attachment table lists only Compensator/Flash Hider (UNVERIFIED). LMG -10% movement (Y9S1). Recoil: low vertical, controllable, accurate (Fandom); reduced in Y9S1. Not the M249 SAW (Gridlock).

name: SR-25
notes: Added to Striker in Y10S3. max_ammo community-measured 20+1+120; Fandom 21+80 (=101) disagrees - chose community (newer). fire_rate community-measured (Fandom ~450). Recoil: vertical and horizontal noticeably worse than other DMRs (Fandom).

name: BOSG.12.2
destruction_class: UNVERIFIED:high (Fandom pros 'High destruction'; destruction range reduced Y9S4.2)
notes: Slug falloff since Y9S4.2: 15->25 m, floor 60%. fire_rate = community-measured interval between barrels (Fandom ~500). Community ammo-refill reload 0.45 / 1.79. Recoil: very high kick per shot; needs a downward 'whip' for the 2nd shot (Fandom).

name: Mk 14 EBR
destruction_class: UNVERIFIED:high (Fandom: 7 shots open an unreinforced hatch)
notes: Y11S3: damage 56 (was 60); first-shot recoil increased (M&K first-shot multiplier 3.5, was 1.8). PER-OPERATOR: Y11S3 removed the Muzzle Brake from ARUNI's Mk 14; Dokkaebi's keeps MB + telescopic per Fandom (verify in-game). max_ammo community 20+1+100; Fandom 21+80 disagrees. Recoil: higher per-shot recoil than other DMRs (Fandom).

name: XK23
penetration_class: UNVERIFIED:simple (AR class; not on Fandom list)
notes: New in Y11S2 (bullpup). Official: 49 dmg, 675 rpm, 35 rds, 5 magazines, 175 total, 'Reload Speed 3.5 sec' (tactical/empty not specified; Fandom 3.35). Extended barrel -> 54 dmg (official), EB min 43 (community). Recoil: 'approachable and consistent' by design (official). Community ammo-refill reload 0.91 / 2.74.

name: L85A2
notes: Recoil: low vertical, high horizontal -> Compensator recommended (Fandom). Fandom infobox 670 rpm but its TTK calc uses 690; community-measured 669. Community ammo-refill reload 1.43 / 2.65. Fandom 31+210 ammo stale.

name: M590A1
notes: Buckshot falloff (Y8S3): 48 at 0-5 m, 36 at 6-10 m, 21 at 13 m+. Y8S3 ranges were 'based on the M590A1'. fire_rate/reloads community-measured (Fandom ~85 rpm). Fandom 7+29 ammo stale.

name: Commando 9
notes: Y9S1 made it a pure AR (was AR/SMG mix). No magnified: defender automatic weapons lost magnified sights in Y10S3. Extended barrel: 40 / min 32 (community). Recoil: low (Fandom). Sentry uses a standard reload animation (Fandom).

name: M870
notes: CONFLICT: community sheet (in-game stat for <=4 m, measured 31 at 6-9 m = 75% of 42) says 42/pellet; Fandom infobox 60 (0-3 m)/20 (12 m+) predates the Y8S3 shotgun rework. Chose 42. Fastest pump of the pump shotguns (Fandom). fire_rate/reloads community-measured.

name: TCSG12
notes: Added to Sentry in Y10S3. Damage 75 since Y9S4.2 (was 63). Defender slugs/DMRs KEEP magnified sights (Y10S3). CONFLICT max ammo: community 10+1+110 = 121 vs Fandom 11+50 = 61. fire_rate community-measured (Fandom ~450). Recoil: high vertical kick, minimal random spread (Fandom).

name: PCX-33
penetration_class: UNVERIFIED:simple (AR class; not on Fandom list)
notes: Each V10 Pantheon shell (Talos/Colossus) has its OWN ammo reserve (Fandom Skopos page); 155 = community 31+1+123 - unclear if per shell. Fandom gives one reload value 3.3 s; community ammo-refill 1.03 / 2.56. Extended barrel 40 / min 32. Community 744 rpm. Recoil: low (Fandom).

name: Vector .45 ACP
notes: Extended barrel 25 / min 20 (community). Recoil: low vertical, unpredictable horizontal; harder at range; Vertical Grip helps (Fandom). Community ammo-refill 0.99 / 2.31.

name: ITA12L
notes: CONFLICT: community measured 40 at 5 m (41 in 2024) and 30 at 6-10 m (=75% of 40); no in-game <=4 m value recorded. Fandom 50 (0-2 m)/30 (12 m+) predates Y8S3. Placeholder 40. Largest pump-shotgun tube (Fandom). fire_rate/reloads community-measured.

name: SIX12 SD
notes: CONFLICT: community sheet 46 (in-game stat) / 34 at 6-10 m; Fandom 35 (0-6 m) predates Y8S3. Reload is a whole-cylinder swap (Fandom 2.608 tac / 2.611 empty; community ammo-refill 1.25 / 2.02). fire_rate community-measured (Fandom ~200). Recoil: high kick per shot (Fandom).

notes: Extended barrel 31 / min 25 (community). Fandom max ammo 31+210 stale (Y6S3 SMG range 170-200). Recoil: low (Fandom). Community ammo-refill 0.99 / 2.33.

notes: Y10S4.2: damage 42 (was 38) and improved lateral recoil. Extended barrel 47 / min 37 (community). Low, gentle recoil (Fandom). Community ammo-refill 1.26 / 2.38.

notes: Handgun falloff community-measured (full to ~11 m, floor ~60% at 14 m+); Fandom template 12->15 m; Fandom infobox '25 at 22 m+' is pre-2024. Suppressed column assumes Y7S3 removal of suppressor damage penalty (Fandom still lists 41 suppressed - stale?). fire_rate community-measured semi cap (Fandom ~550). Max ammo community 12+1+84; Fandom 13+48 stale.

notes: Secondary shotgun used mainly for utility destruction; tight hip-fire spread can fail to open a hatch in one shot (Fandom Destruction). Fandom max 3+42 (45) vs community 3+43 (46) - Y6S3 gave every weapon +1 round, so 46 chosen. fire_rate/reloads community-measured (Fandom ~85).

name: PMM
notes: CONFLICT: community 61 (measured since 2024) vs Fandom 63. With Ballistic Shield, pistol ADS = 0.50 s walking / 0.55 s sprinting. Low recoil, very fast reload (Fandom). Max ammo community 8+1+72; Fandom 9+40 stale.

name: GSh-18
notes: Laser added in Y7S3 (Fandom attachment table omits it - stale). With Ballistic Shield, pistol ADS 0.50/0.55 s. Low recoil per shot, steep falloff (Fandom). Max ammo community 18+1+90; Fandom 19+54 stale.

notes: Machine-pistol falloff community-measured (18->28 m, ~60% floor); Fandom template 20->28. Somewhat harsh recoil but lower ROF than other MPs (Fandom). Max ammo community 26+1+104; Fandom 27+78 stale (Y6S3 secondary SMG range 112-140).

name: GONNE-6
destruction_class: UNVERIFIED:explosive (one shot opens an unreinforced hatch; makes a small hole in soft walls)
notes: Takes the secondary-weapon slot. Straight-line, no-gravity projectile that detonates on impact; destroys gadgets incl. bulletproof ones (radius ~0.5 m bulletproof / ~0.75 m others). Explosion 10/5/3 dmg by (pre-Y6S3) armor class + 10 on direct hit. Destroys barricades and Castle panels; disables Aruni gates 30 s. Intercepted by Jager ADS and Wamai Mag-NET. Does not knock back ballistic shields; unaffected by electrified surfaces. All from Fandom (older page).

notes: Y11S3 (official): damage 16 (was 28), mag 22 (was 32), max ammo 111 (was 129). Recoil: high vertical+horizontal; drifts left on shots 4-13 then right/left (Fandom). Community 1273 rpm.

notes: Low recoil jack-of-all-trades (Fandom). Max ammo community 15+1+81; Fandom 16+45 stale.
